## reservations

- **Tân từ**: Độc giả reader_id xếp hàng đặt trước đầu sách book_id vào lúc requested_at; khi sẵn sàng thì giữ một bản sao cho đến hold_expires_at.
- **Predicate**: Reader reader_id queued for book book_id at requested_at; when ready it holds one copy until hold_expires_at.

| Column | Type | Null | Default / generated | Key |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | bigint | no |  | PRI |
| `reader_id` | bigint | no |  | MUL |
| `book_id` | bigint | no |  | MUL |
| `requested_at` | datetime(3) | no |  |  |
| `status` | enum('waiting','ready','fulfilled','cancelled','expired') | no |  |  |
| `assigned_copy_id` | bigint | yes |  | MUL |
| `ready_at` | datetime(3) | yes |  |  |
| `hold_expires_at` | datetime(3) | yes |  |  |
| `fulfilled_loan_item_id` | bigint | yes |  | UNI |
| `closed_at` | datetime(3) | yes |  |  |
| `close_reason` | varchar(64) | yes |  |  |
| `closed_by_kind` | enum('staff','reader','system') | yes |  |  |
| `closed_by_user_id` | bigint | yes |  | MUL |
| `active_flag` | tinyint | yes | GENERATED: `` if((`status` in ('waiting','ready')),1,NULL) `` |  |
| `ready_copy_id` | bigint | yes | GENERATED: `` if((`status` = 'ready'),`assigned_copy_id`,NULL) `` | UNI |

**Keys**

- PRIMARY KEY `PRIMARY` (id)
- UNIQUE `reservations_active_uq` (reader_id,book_id,active_flag)
- UNIQUE `reservations_fulfilled_item_uq` (fulfilled_loan_item_id)
- UNIQUE `reservations_ready_copy_uq` (ready_copy_id)
- FOREIGN KEY `reservations_book_fk` (book_id) → `books`(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
- FOREIGN KEY `reservations_closed_by_fk` (closed_by_user_id) → `app_users`(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
- FOREIGN KEY `reservations_copy_book_fk` (assigned_copy_id,book_id) → `book_copies`(id,book_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
- FOREIGN KEY `reservations_fulfilled_item_fk` (fulfilled_loan_item_id) → `loan_items`(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
- FOREIGN KEY `reservations_reader_fk` (reader_id) → `readers`(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

**CHECK constraints**

- `reservations_closed_ck`: `` ((`status` not in ('cancelled','expired','fulfilled')) or (`closed_at` is not null)) ``
- `reservations_fulfilled_ck`: `` ((`status` <> 'fulfilled') or (`fulfilled_loan_item_id` is not null)) ``
- `reservations_ready_ck`: `` ((`status` <> 'ready') or ((`assigned_copy_id` is not null) and (`ready_at` is not null) and (`hold_expires_at` is not null) and (`hold_expires_at` > `ready_at`))) ``
